title: เช็คราคาทองวันนี้ 4 กันยายน 2569 ล่าสุด ราคาปรับเพิ่ม 650 บาท ราคาทองรูปพรรณ บาทละ 70,600 บาท

title_cn: 今日金价上扬 黄金饰品每克报价 70,600 泰铢
summary_cn: 泰国黄金价格 9 月 4 日更新，较前日上涨 650 泰铢。其中黄金饰品(ทองรูปพรรณ)每克报价 70,600 泰铢，金条(ทองคำแท่ง)每克 69,800 泰铢，黄金 1 钱报价 17,450 泰铢，根据泰国黄金商协会最新公告。

title: รัฐบาลเร่งดัน SME ใช้สิทธิ FTA ลดต้นทุนภาษี ครึ่งปีแรกใช้สิทธิแล้ว 1.57 ล้านล้าน โต 7.33%
desc: รัฐบาลเร่งดัน SME ใช้สิทธิจากความตกลงการค้าเสรี (FTA) ลดต้นทุนทางภาษี เพิ่มแต้มต่อส่งออก หลังครึ่งปีแรกใช้สิทธิแล้ว 1.57 ล้านล้านบาท โต 7.33%
title_cn: 泰国政府推动中小企业利用 FTA 权益降低税收成本
summary_cn: 泰国政府积极推动中小企业(SME)利用自由贸易协定(FTA)权益降低商品出口的税收负担。今年上半年中小企业已利用 FTA 权益金额达 1.57 万亿泰铢，同比增长 7.33%，有助于增强企业国际竞争力。
desc_original: รัฐบาลเร่งดัน SME ใช้สิทธิจากความตกลงการค้าเสรี (FTA) ลดต้นทุนทางภาษี เพิ่มแต้มต่อส่งออก หลังครึ่งปีแรกใช้สิทธิแล้ว 1.57 ล้านล้านบาท โต 7.33%

title: ปั๊มบางจาก บลูมมิ่ง เทลส์ พุทธมณฑลสาย 3 ซิวรางวัลห้องน้ำสะอาดแห่งปี กทม.2569 ต่อเนื่อง 2 ปีซ้อน
desc: สถานีบริการน้ำมันบางจาก บลูมมิ่งเทลส์ @พุทธมณฑลสาย 3 ได้รับรางวัล สุดยอดห้องน้ำแห่งปีของกรุงเทพมหานคร ประจำปี 2569 กลุ่มสถานีบริการเชื้อเพลิง จากกรุงเทพมหานคร เป็นปีที่ 2 ติดต่อกัน
title_cn: 曼谷邦查克加油站连获佳绩 连续两年获评年度最佳卫生间
summary_cn: 位于曼谷佛统湾(Phutthamonthon)路 3 号线的邦查克(Bangchak) Blooming Tales 加油站再次获得曼谷 2026 年度最佳卫生间奖。这是该加油站在加油站类别中连续第二年获此殊荣，彰显了其对公共设施卫生维护的持续重视。

summary_cn: 泰国达府(Trat)村级五戒推广委员会在象岛(Koh Chang)开展宣传活动。府尹强调遵守五戒(Sila)规范对建设和谐社会的重要作用，有利于民众身心健康、心态安宁，营造正常祥和的社会环境。

summary_cn: 泰国议员沃拉萨克(Worsit)在国会与议员艾丝·拉克尚(Ice Rachanok)发生激烈辩论。沃拉萨克强调曾亲自视察南部问题地区巴陶府(Pattani)和也拉府(Yala)至凌晨 2 点，表示不求外界认可，并以犀利言辞指「有时不了解不发言反而有益」。

title: Court ruling fails to settle NBTC chair dispute
desc: A former commissioner of the National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) has urged any party affected by the dispute over the chairman's qualification to ask the Central Administrative Court to make a definitive ruling on the chairman's legal status.
title_cn: 法院裁决无法平息泰国广播电视通信委员会主席纠纷
summary_cn: 泰国国家广播电视通信委员会（NBTC, National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission）前任委员呼吁相关各方向行政法院提起诉讼，争取对现任主席法律身份的明确裁定，以彻底解决权限争议。
desc_original: A former commissioner of the National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) has urged any party affected by the dispute over the chairman's qualification to ask the Central Administrative Court to make a definitive ruling on the chairman's legal status.

title_cn: 「泰国旅游泰国Plus」计划增加每日津贴
summary_cn: 泰国财政次长确认「泰国旅游泰国Plus」（Thailand Tourism Plus）计划将提高每日津贴金额，以防止酒店涨价，项目预计融资超过20亿泰铢，用于在淡季刺激国内旅游消费和产业发展。

title: เนสท์เล่เพิ่มการลงทุนในไทย ทุ่ม 6.4 พันล้านขยายฐานผลิตอาหารสัตว์เลี้ยง
desc: “เนสท์เล่” เดินหน้าขยายฐานผลิตอาหารสัตว์เลี้ยงในไทย มูลค่า 6,430 ล้านบาท ที่นิคมฯ อมตะซิตี้ ระยอง ชูศักยภาพไทยผู้ส่งออกอาหารสัตว์เลี้ยงอันดับ 2 ของโลก เป็นการขยายการลงทุนในไทยต่อเนื่อง
title_cn: 雀巢追加64亿泰铢投资 扩建罗勇宠物食品产业基地
summary_cn: 全球食品集团雀巢（Nestlé）继续扩大在泰国的投资，在罗勇府（Rayong）Amata City工业园追加投资64.3亿泰铢，用于扩建宠物食品生产基地，进一步彰显泰国作为全球第二大宠物食品出口国的产业优势。
desc_original: “เนสท์เล่” เดินหน้าขยายฐานผลิตอาหารสัตว์เลี้ยงในไทย มูลค่า 6,430 ล้านบาท ที่นิคมฯ อมตะซิตี้ ระยอง ชูศักยภาพไทยผู้ส่งออกอาหารสัตว์เลี้ยงอันดับ 2 ของโลก เป็นการขยายการลงทุนในไทยต่อเนื่อง

title: Central Group appoints Wallaya Chirathivat president
desc: Central Group has announced the appointment of Wallaya Chirathivat as president, strengthening its senior leadership team and positioning the organisation for future growth.
title_cn: Central Group 宣布任命 Wallaya Chirathivat 为总裁
summary_cn: Central Group 宣布任命 Wallaya Chirathivat 为总裁，进一步加强公司高层管理团队。Wallaya Chirathivat 系零售业知名的 Chirathivat 家族成员，该任命标志着这家泰国主要零售商业集团的重要人事变动，将影响集团的战略方向和长期发展规划。
desc_original: Central Group has announced the appointment of Wallaya Chirathivat as president, strengthening its senior leadership team and positioning the organisation for future growth.

title: ดันพิมพ์เขียวสกัดโกงออนไลน์ รัฐ-เอกชนโหมโรงจัดประชุมIMF-World Bank
desc: ภาครัฐ-เอกชนจัด The Bangkok Business Summit 2026 โหมโรงก่อนประชุม IMF-World Bank นายกฯ ประกาศความพร้อมไทยสู่สปริงบอร์ดเชื่อมอาเซียน ธปท.เปิด "Bangkok Blueprint"ต้นแบบสกัดภัยไซเบอร์ระดับโลก
title_cn: 泰国力推网络安全防护，Bangkok Business Summit 2026 为 IMF-World Bank 年会预热
summary_cn: 泰国政府与私人部门联合举办 The Bangkok Business Summit 2026，为即将召开的国际货币基金组织与世界银行年会做准备。总理宣布泰国作为连接东盟 ASEAN 区域的枢纽准备就绪，泰央行推出「Bangkok Blueprint」作为全球网络安全防范的标杆方案，旨在打击网络欺诈和数据威胁。
desc_original: ภาครัฐ-เอกชนจัด The Bangkok Business Summit 2026 โหมโรงก่อนประชุม IMF-World Bank นายกฯ ประกาศความพร้อมไทยสู่สปริงบอร์ดเชื่อมอาเซียน ธปท.เปิด "Bangkok Blueprint"ต้นแบบสกัดภัยไซเบอร์ระดับโลก

title: 'Fake father' scheme poses security risk, panel warns
desc: The House Committee on Public Health has urged authorities to step up investigations into "fake father" networks, warning that foreigners fraudulently registered as Thai could eventually gain the right to own property and enter politics.
title_cn: 「假父亲」骗局构成国家安全隐患，议会敦促严查
summary_cn: 泰国众议院公共卫生委员会敦促当局加大对「假父亲」诈骗网络的调查力度。该骗局涉及外国人通过欺诈手段非法注册成泰国籍，最终可能获得购买房产和参与政治活动的权利，构成严重国家安全风险。此类身份造假问题直接威胁泰国的法律制度和外籍人口管理秩序。
desc_original: The House Committee on Public Health has urged authorities to step up investigations into "fake father" networks, warning that foreigners fraudulently registered as Thai could eventually gain the right to own property and enter politics.

title: Parliament  rejects air bill changes
desc: The House of Representatives has rejected Senate amendments to the Clean Air Management Bill, voting instead to set up a joint committee to reconsider changes that MPs say would weaken pollution controls.
title_cn: 泰国众议院驳回《清洁空气管理法案》修正案
summary_cn: 泰国众议院否决了参议院对《清洁空气管理法案》的修改提议，决定成立联合委员会重新审议。众议院议员表示参议院修正案将削弱污染防控效力。该法案的最终版本将直接影响曼谷及全国的空气质量标准，进而关系到所有居民的公共卫生和日常生活质量。
desc_original: The House of Representatives has rejected Senate amendments to the Clean Air Management Bill, voting instead to set up a joint committee to reconsider changes that MPs say would weaken pollution controls.

title: Call-centre scams cost retirees billions
desc: Cyber police have warned retirees and older people about call-centre scams after losses among victims aged 60 and above reached 3.15 billion baht in eight months.
title_cn: 电话诈骗猖獗，泰国老年人八个月损失逾31.5亿泰铢
summary_cn: 泰国网络警察部门发出警告，针对老年人和退休人员的呼叫中心诈骗案件激增。过去八个月内，年龄在60岁以上的受害者累计损失达31.5亿泰铢 Thai Baht。诈骗集团常以虚假投资、亲属急难、税务问题等借口行骗，对包括外国退休人士在内的群体构成严重财产威胁。
desc_original: Cyber police have warned retirees and older people about call-centre scams after losses among victims aged 60 and above reached 3.15 billion baht in eight months.

title: Parit queried on sources of leaked report
desc: People's Party MP Parit Wacharasindhu was questioned on Thursday by a House committee on police affairs about the sources of information he cited in allegations of collusion in the Senate election.
title_cn: 人民党议员帕里特被质询泄露报告信息来源
summary_cn: 人民党议员帕里特（Parit Wacharasindhu）周四被众议院警务委员会质询，内容涉及其在参议院选举串通指控中所引用的信息来源。此事反映了泰国政治中对选举过程透明度和权力制衡的持续关注。
desc_original: People's Party MP Parit Wacharasindhu was questioned on Thursday by a House committee on police affairs about the sources of information he cited in allegations of collusion in the Senate election.

title: Nectec steps up push for tech sovereignty
desc: The National Electronics and Computer Technology Center (Nectec) has estimated its research generates an economic impact of more than 10 billion baht annually as the agency shifts its focus towards technological sovereignty and steps up investment in quantum technology, physical artificial intelligence (AI) and space communications.
title_cn: 泰国国家电子计算机技术中心推进科技自主战略
summary_cn: 泰国国家电子计算机技术中心（Nectec）宣布其研究每年产生超 100 亿泰铢的经济效益，并加大对量子技术、物理人工智能和空间通信的投资，将重点转向科技自主和战略自给，标志着泰国在科技领域的长期战略布局。
desc_original: The National Electronics and Computer Technology Center (Nectec) has estimated its research generates an economic impact of more than 10 billion baht annually as the agency shifts its focus towards technological sovereignty and steps up investment in quantum technology, physical artificial intelligence (AI) and space communications.

title: Phuket records a foreign arrival rebound in July
desc: Phuket's foreign arrivals are rebounding as the impact of the Middle East conflict subsides, but the hospitality sector still faces challenges from tighter consumer spending and intensifying competition.
title_cn: 普吉岛七月外国游客到访数反弹
summary_cn: 随着中东冲突影响逐渐消退，普吉岛外国游客到访数出现反弹。但酒店业仍面临消费支出收紧和竞争加剧的压力。这反映了泰国作为旅游目的地的吸引力恢复情况。
desc_original: Phuket's foreign arrivals are rebounding as the impact of the Middle East conflict subsides, but the hospitality sector still faces challenges from tighter consumer spending and intensifying competition.

title: Court talks address online crime
desc: The Criminal Court has brought together police, banks, the media and the Anti-Money Laundering Office (Amlo) to discuss ways to tackle online crime, which the court says now accounts for over half of its cases.
title_cn: 法院会议聚焦网络犯罪治理
summary_cn: 泰国刑事法院联合警察、银行、媒体和反洗钱办公室（Amlo）召开会议，讨论应对网络犯罪的措施。网络犯罪现已占该法院案件的一半以上，对在泰外国人的信息安全和资金安全具有重要威胁。
desc_original: The Criminal Court has brought together police, banks, the media and the Anti-Money Laundering Office (Amlo) to discuss ways to tackle online crime, which the court says now accounts for over half of its cases.

title: Data centres advise balance in regulations
desc: Amid tighter scrutiny of data centres over fuel safety, zoning and environmental concerns, Thailand should close regulatory gaps without an overcorrection that could undermine investment, capitalising on the industry's expansion to build a higher-value domestic artificial intelligence (AI) supply chain, according to the Thailand Data Center Association (TDCA).
title_cn: 数据中心业界呼吁监管平衡
summary_cn: 在燃料安全、分区和环保审查加强的背景下，泰国数据中心协会（TDCA）表示应补全监管漏洞但避免过度管制打击投资。业界建议利用产业扩张机遇建立高价值的本地人工智能产业链，对泰国长期经济发展战略意义重大。
desc_original: Amid tighter scrutiny of data centres over fuel safety, zoning and environmental concerns, Thailand should close regulatory gaps without an overcorrection that could undermine investment, capitalising on the industry's expansion to build a higher-value domestic artificial intelligence (AI) supply chain, according to the Thailand Data Center Association (TDCA).

title: Maid’s 100-million-baht windfall exposes illegal firms
desc: Maid’s 100-million-baht windfall exposes illegal firms Legacy Police in Surat Thani have concluded their investigation into two nominee companies linked to a French businesswoman who died by suicide on Koh Samui in 2024, recommending prosecution over illegal landholding through Thai nominees. The case, which drew national attention after the woman left a fortune worth nearly 100 million baht to her housekeeper, has now moved to the Koh Samui prosecutor’s office. Investigating Officer Police Lieutenant Colonel Kittisak Charoenroop of Surat Thani City Police submitted the finalised case file for signature by Police Major General Suwat Suksri, commander of the Surat Thani Provincial Police. The file recommends prosecuting G.V.N.E. Co., Ltd. and Maxicate Co., Ltd. for operating as foreign nominee companies engaged in land trading, in breach of the Foreign Business Act. Investigators also recommended charges against two Thai nationals accused of supporting the illegal arrangement. title: LISA releases ‘SaWaDiKa’ as new single puts Thai identity on the global stage
desc: LISA releases ‘SaWaDiKa’ as new single puts Thai identity on the global stage Legacy The Thai superstar opens her PRESS PLAY era with a song named after Thailand’s best-known greeting, backed by visuals featuring Muay Thai, tuk-tuks and Bangkok. LISA has officially released her new single “SaWaDiKa” on September 4, turning one of Thailand’s most familiar greetings into the title of a global pop release. The song premiered at 7am Thailand time through LLOUD Official. It serves as the first single from LISA’s upcoming six-track EP PRESS PLAY, which is scheduled for release on October 23. Its title is a stylised version of “sawasdee ka”, the polite Thai greeting used by women. Rather than keeping the Thai connection in the background, LISA has made it central to the campaign. Promotional images and videos have featured Muay Thai-inspired styling and a blue-and-red tuk-tuk. The two elements are instantly recognisable as Thai, and they arrive here through a contemporary pop and fashion aesthetic. title: Australia eyes drug production potential
desc: Australia is exploring Thailand as a potential manufacturing base and regional hub for complementary medicines, as Australian businesses seek to expand investment and long-term cooperation.
title_cn: 澳大利亚看好泰国药物生产潜力
summary_cn: 澳大利亚正在探索泰国作为互补医药（保健品补充剂）生产制造基地和地区贸易枢纽的潜力。澳大利亚企业部门寻求在泰国扩大投资规模并建立长期合作关系。此举反映出泰国作为东南亚医药制造中心的战略价值不断提升，同时表明该产业对国际资本的吸引力持续增强，有助于推动泰国制造业转型升级。
desc_original: Australia is exploring Thailand as a potential manufacturing base and regional hub for complementary medicines, as Australian businesses seek to expand investment and long-term cooperation.

title: BMA stepping  up checks on  Chabad houses
desc: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) is stepping up inspections of Chabad house facilities in Bangkok amid concerns over their expansion in areas popular with Israeli tourists and foreign residents.
title_cn: 曼谷都市局加强ChaBaD中心监管检查
summary_cn: 曼谷都市局（BMA）正在加强对ChaBaD中心设施的检查。此举针对这些设施在以色列游客和外国居民集中区域的扩张。ChaBaD是正统犹太教国际组织，在曼谷外籍社群中有较多分布。当局的监管举措可能涉及安全、卫生、许可证或房屋用途等常规检查，反映出曼谷对外籍人士聚集区的日常管理动态。
desc_original: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) is stepping up inspections of Chabad house facilities in Bangkok amid concerns over their expansion in areas popular with Israeli tourists and foreign residents.

title: Doctor faces probe over 'low class' jibe
desc: A Bangkok doctor accused of threatening a kidney patient and describing beneficiaries of the 30-baht universal healthcare scheme as "low-class people" faces an investigation by the Ministry of Public Health.
title_cn: 医生因侮辱医保患者遭卫生部调查
summary_cn: 曼谷一名医生因威胁肾脏病患者、公开贬低30泰铢全民医保受益人为「低等阶级」而接受泰国公共卫生部调查。该事件涉及医德操守与社会阶层歧视问题，引发公众关注。30泰铢医保计划是泰国政府面向低收入群体的重要社保项目，医疗工作者的不当言行可能引发更广泛的社会讨论与行业整顿。
desc_original: A Bangkok doctor accused of threatening a kidney patient and describing beneficiaries of the 30-baht universal healthcare scheme as "low-class people" faces an investigation by the Ministry of Public Health.

title: Sondhi planning street mobilisation
desc: Political tensions are mounting as veteran protest leader Sondhi Limthongkul prepares to announce a street mobilisation campaign, prompting Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul to warn that demonstrations must follow the law.
title_cn: 抗议领袖宋迪·林通库尔 Sondhi Limthongkul 筹划街头动员活动
summary_cn: 资深政治活动人士宋迪·林通库尔正筹划大规模街头动员活动，引发泰国政治局势进一步升温。总理阿努廷·查尔维拉库尔 Anutin Charnvirakul 随即发出严厉警告，强调任何形式的示威活动必须严格遵守法律。这反映出泰国政坛长期存在的政治分歧和社会分裂。
desc_original: Political tensions are mounting as veteran protest leader Sondhi Limthongkul prepares to announce a street mobilisation campaign, prompting Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul to warn that demonstrations must follow the law.

title: State firms attempt to retain older talent
desc: The Finance Ministry has proposed amending the law to raise the age limits for chief executives and board members of state-owned enterprises, addressing the challenges of an ageing society.
title_cn: 泰国国企修法提高管理层年龄限制
summary_cn: 为应对人口老龄化导致的人才流失，泰国财政部提议修改法律，提高国有企业首席执行官和董事会成员的强制退休年龄限制。这一改革旨在留住具有丰富经验的资深管理人才，确保国企的长期稳定运营和战略连贯性，是泰国适应老龄化社会的重要举措。
desc_original: The Finance Ministry has proposed amending the law to raise the age limits for chief executives and board members of state-owned enterprises, addressing the challenges of an ageing society.

title: ถี่ยิบ เสาไฟโซลาร์เซลล์ 9.9 ล้าน นายกเทศมนตรี ชี้เหมาะสม คุ้มค่า เกิดประโยชน์ต่อชุมชน
desc: เสาไฟโซลาร์เซลล์ งบ 9.9 ล้านบาท โซเชียลตั้งข้อสงสัย “มันถี่เกินไปไหม” นายกเทศมนตรีตำบลนิคมคำสร้อย ชี้แจงแล้ว ระบุเหมาะสม คุ้มค่า เกิดประโยชน์ต่อชุมชน
title_cn: 尼科姆坎萨罗依镇太阳能路灯项目引发热议
summary_cn: 尼科姆坎萨罗依镇 Nikom Khamsakroy 耗资990万泰铢的太阳能路灯项目在社交媒体引发民众质疑，有人批评路灯布设密度过高。镇长随后出面澄清，辩称该项目规划科学、成本合理，能为当地居民提供可靠电力和夜间安全保障，符合可持续发展方向。
desc_original: เสาไฟโซลาร์เซลล์ งบ 9.9 ล้านบาท โซเชียลตั้งข้อสงสัย “มันถี่เกินไปไหม” นายกเทศมนตรีตำบลนิคมคำสร้อย ชี้แจงแล้ว ระบุเหมาะสม คุ้มค่า เกิดประโยชน์ต่อชุมชน

title: World Bank calls for broader AI adoption in Thailand
desc: Thailand is well-positioned to harness artificial intelligence (AI) to not only lift productivity, but also develop new industries and create more high-skilled jobs, though the challenge remains how to ensure AI is available to all companies, says the World Bank.
title_cn: 世界银行敦促泰国加快人工智能应用
summary_cn: 世界银行发布报告指出泰国具备利用人工智能提升生产力、催生新兴产业、创造高技能就业的良好条件。但报告也指出，当前泰国面临的关键挑战是如何确保中小企业和偏远地区也能平等获得人工智能技术支持，实现包容性的经济转型和高质量发展。
desc_original: Thailand is well-positioned to harness artificial intelligence (AI) to not only lift productivity, but also develop new industries and create more high-skilled jobs, though the challenge remains how to ensure AI is available to all companies, says the World Bank.

title: Thailand's finance minister pushes regional economic integration
desc: Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas has outlined a vision to position Thailand and the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) as a network of “trusted connectors” capable of navigating an increasingly fragmented global economy.
title_cn: 泰国财长推动东盟地区经济一体化
summary_cn: 副总理兼财政部长埃克尼迪·尼地坦普拉帕斯 Ekniti Nitithanprapas 提出宏大愿景，主张将泰国和东盟打造成「可信赖的经济连接者」网络。面对全球经济格局分化加剧，泰国拟发挥地区经济枢纽作用，通过强化跨国商贸投资合作，推动东盟在国际经济体系中的影响力。
desc_original: Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Ekniti Nitithanprapas has outlined a vision to position Thailand and the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) as a network of “trusted connectors” capable of navigating an increasingly fragmented global economy.

title: Leaders promote resilience as competitive advantage
desc: Thailand must turn global disruptions such as geopolitical tensions, artificial intelligence (AI) and slowing growth into long-term economic opportunities through coordinated investment, according to business leaders at Bangkok Business Summit 2026.
title_cn: 商界领袖倡导韧性成为竞争优势
summary_cn: 曼谷商业峰会2026的商界领袖认为，泰国应将地缘政治紧张局势、人工智能（AI）和经济增长放缓等全球性挑战转化为长期经济机会，通过协调投资予以解决。
desc_original: Thailand must turn global disruptions such as geopolitical tensions, artificial intelligence (AI) and slowing growth into long-term economic opportunities through coordinated investment, according to business leaders at Bangkok Business Summit 2026.

title: Thai lawmaker gets messages of support from Myanmar citizens after protest
desc: A Thai opposition lawmaker who drew wide attention for disrupting his country's official welcome of Myanmar military chief-turned-President Min Aung Hlaing last month said he received many messages from Myanmar citizens supporting his action, which he said was meant as a protest against military rule.
title_cn: 泰国议员因抗议缅甸军政权获缅甸民众声援
summary_cn: 一位泰国反对党议员因上月打断泰国对缅甸军人出身总统敏昂莱（Min Aung Hlaing）的官方欢迎仪式而引发关注。他表示收到许多缅甸民众支持信息，声称其行动旨在抗议缅甸的军事独裁统治。
desc_original: A Thai opposition lawmaker who drew wide attention for disrupting his country's official welcome of Myanmar military chief-turned-President Min Aung Hlaing last month said he received many messages from Myanmar citizens supporting his action, which he said was meant as a protest against military rule.

desc: สรุปแนวคิดของเหล่าผู้นำที่มีบทบาทต่อเศรษฐกิจไทยตั้งแต่ อนุทิน ชาญวีรกูล นายกรัฐมนตรี, กระทรวงการคลัง, ธนาคารแห่งประเทศไทย และกกร. จากการประชุมสุดยอดผู้นำ The Bangkok Business Summit 2026
title_cn: 泰国经济何去何从？总理、财政部、央行在商业峰会论经济前景
summary_cn: 曼谷商业峰会2026汇聚了对泰国经济具有影响力的领导人物，包括总理阿努廷·占维路（Annutin Charnvirakul）、财政部、泰国央行（BOT）和竞争委员会等，就泰国经济发展方向提出战略观点。

title: ถอดรหัสรายงานธนาคารโลก Building Thailand’s Future Today ปฏิรูปโครงสร้างเศรษฐกิจ
desc: รายงานธนาคารโลกฉบับใหม่ ‘Building Thailand’s Future Today’ เป้าหมายดันไทยสู่ประเทศรายได้สูงในปี 2037 เร่ง GDP โต 5.4% ผ่านการปฏิรูปโครงสร้างเศรษฐกิจ 4 เสาหลักสำคัญ และ 5 อุตสาหกรรมแห่งอนาคต
title_cn: 世界银行新报告：通过结构改革推进泰国未来建设
summary_cn: 世界银行最新报告「今日建设泰国未来」（Building Thailand's Future Today）提出2037年晋升高收入国家目标，需通过经济结构改革实现GDP年增速5.4%，涉及4大经济支柱和5个前瞻性产业发展。
desc_original: รายงานธนาคารโลกฉบับใหม่ ‘Building Thailand’s Future Today’ เป้าหมายดันไทยสู่ประเทศรายได้สูงในปี 2037 เร่ง GDP โต 5.4% ผ่านการปฏิรูปโครงสร้างเศรษฐกิจ 4 เสาหลักสำคัญ และ 5 อุตสาหกรรมแห่งอนาคต

title: US sailors on leave begin exploring Pattaya
desc: PATTAYA - Hordes of US sailors were up early on Thursday as they set out to explore this tourist city on their second day of shore leave.
title_cn: 美国海军水手开始游览芭提雅
summary_cn: 大批美国海军休假水手周四一早启程探索芭提雅旅游城市，这是他们执行访泰任务期间上岸休假的第二天。
desc_original: PATTAYA - Hordes of US sailors were up early on Thursday as they set out to explore this tourist city on their second day of shore leave.

title: Kamphaeng Phet school shooter faces charges
desc: The teenage student who fired multiple shots at his school in Kamphaeng Phet province faces several charges, while the school has been closed for two days to review and improve safety measures.
title_cn: 甲米林府（Kamphaeng Phet）校园枪击案：少年枪手面临多项指控
summary_cn: 甲米林府一所学校发生枪击事件，涉事少年学生已被指控多项罪名。学校已关闭两天进行安全评估和改善措施，以防止类似事件再发。
desc_original: The teenage student who fired multiple shots at his school in Kamphaeng Phet province faces several charges, while the school has been closed for two days to review and improve safety measures.

title: เมื่อโลกไม่กลับไปเหมือนเดิม ประเทศไทยต้องลงทุนอะไร? เพื่อให้ภาคธุรกิจเติบโตได้ท่ามกลางความผันผวน
desc: เปิดมุมมอง 4 ผู้นำธุรกิจใหญ่ CP-KBank-B.Grimm-Indorama Ventures ชี้ทางออกเศรษฐกิจไทย ต้องเร่งลงทุน “คน-เทคโนโลยี-โครงสร้างพื้นฐาน-ระบบการเงิน” พลิกความผันผวนเป็นโอกาส เชื่อมไทยสู่ตลาดโลก

desc: Thailand is well suited for global investments with strengths and a strategic geographical location to benefit businesses, Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said on Thursday.

title: Bangkok’s new electric bus fleet nears production
desc: Bangkok’s new electric bus fleet nears production Legacy The Bangkok Mass Transit Authority (BMTA) is preparing to roll out 1,520 electric buses under a seven-year, 14.9 billion baht lease agreement with Nakhonchai Air Co, Ltd, with the first deliveries expected by the end of March 2027 . BMTA Director Kittikan Chomdoung Charuworapolkul visited the production line of Absolute Assembly Company Limited (AAB) in Chachoengsao province yesterday, September 2, to inspect progress on the buses, which are being manufactured and assembled by NEX Point Public Company Limited on Nakhonchai Air’s behalf. Kittikan said the transition would raise standards of passenger convenience, safety and environmental performance, while helping resolve the BMTA’s long-standing debt problems . He said the organisation expects to cut its operating costs by around 4.1 billion baht a year once the new fleet and supporting systems are fully in place. Core components for the first 40 buses have already reached the assembly plant, which has a maximum production capacity of 15 buses a day, although the BMTA has set a minimum target of 12 a day. title: Sea turtle found stranded and weak on Phuket’s Patong Beach
desc: Sea turtle found stranded and weak on Phuket’s Patong Beach Legacy A sea turtle weighing more than 50 kilogrammes was found stranded on Patong Beach in Phuket today, September 3. The animal was weak and exhausted. It lay on the shore in Patong subdistrict, in Kathu district. Jiraporn Wijit was walking along Patong Beach at around 6am and spotted the turtle on the sand, Khaosod English reported. She then alerted lifeguards stationed at the beach. The lifeguards moved the turtle away from the shoreline. They gave the animal first aid. They also kept its condition under watch while help was arranged. The lifeguards contacted the Siritharn Rare Marine Animal Rescue Centre to take over the animal’s care. The centre is based at the Upper Andaman Marine and Coastal Resources Research Centre in Laem Phanwa, Wichit subdistrict, Muang Phuket district. According to The Phuket News and Thai Rath, the turtle was due to be handed over to the Sireetarn team for a health examination and any necessary treatment, though the two outlets differed on whether this had already happened by the time of publication. The plan is for the centre to care for the turtle until it has recovered enough

title: Courtyard Marriott Patong invites guests to dine and unwind by the beach
desc: Courtyard Marriott Patong invites guests to dine and unwind by the beach Legacy Courtyard by Marriott Phuket, Patong Beach Resort is inviting guests to discover nine ways to dine and unwind, with restaurants, bars and poolside venues located just steps from Patong Beach. From the first coffee of the morning to cocktails under the stars, the resort’s dining collection is designed to match different moods, travel styles and moments throughout the day. Guests can enjoy casual café stops, beachfront bites, wood-fired pizzas, international flavours, smoky barbecue, refreshing cocktails and relaxed poolside dining without leaving the resort. Each venue brings its own character, from lively social spaces to relaxed tables by the water, while reflecting the energetic atmosphere of Phuket ’s well-known beach district. title: 1 in 5 children face child sexual abuse online: UNICEF
desc: 1 in 5 children face child sexual abuse online: UNICEF Legacy One in five internet-using children across 21 countries, including Thailand, has experienced online sexual exploitation or abuse in a single year, according to a new UNICEF report described as one of the largest studies ever conducted on the issue. The report, titled Through Children’s Eyes: How Digital Technologies Enable Child Sexual Abuse, was released by UNICEF’s Office of Research this week. It draws on surveys of about 21,000 internet-using children aged 12 to 17, alongside in-depth interviews with 100 young people who experienced abuse in childhood. The research estimates that around 20 million children across the 21 countries surveyed were sexually exploited or abused through digital technologies in a single year. More than 15 million children were exposed to unwanted sexual content, more than 9 million were pressured into sexual conversations or asked to share sexual images, and about 4 million had sexual images shared without their consent. title: Thai AirAsia’s Silver Care offers seniors free perks
desc: Thai AirAsia’s Silver Care offers seniors free perks Legacy Thai AirAsia has launched Silver Care, a free service for passengers aged 60 and above on all its domestic flights in Thailand , the airline announced on September 2. The package includes priority check-in, priority baggage claim and a Seat Together service, which places a senior passenger next to a travelling companion, subject to standard seat availability. None of the three benefits carries an extra charge, and all apply across every domestic route the airline flies. Eligible passengers must present a valid ID card at the check-in counter. The privileges extend to one travel companion, meaning a senior passenger and a companion can check in together. At Don Mueang International Airport, Silver Care check-in takes place at a dedicated counter, 10J, in Domestic Terminal 2. Staff attach a special priority tag to checked luggage, which the airline said is intended to speed up baggage claim at the destination airport. title: Phuket Marriott Merlin Beach adds new dining venues and family Splash Zone
desc: Phuket Marriott Merlin Beach adds new dining venues and family Splash Zone Legacy Phuket Marriott Resort & Spa, Merlin Beach has launched three new facilities, Kanpai, La Cala and the Splash Zone, to enhance the guest experience for leisure travellers and families staying at the beachfront resort in Phuket. The additions are designed to broaden the resort’s dining and recreational offering, giving guests more options for international cuisine and family activities without leaving the property. Travellers planning a beachfront stay can explore the resort’s latest facilities and reserve accommodation through the official Marriott website . La Cala introduces a refined Italian dining experience to the resort, with a menu focused on premium ingredients and authentic Italian dishes. The venue is designed for guests looking for an elegant setting for evening dining during their stay. La Cala Kanpai adds a Japanese dining option to the resort’s culinary line-up. The outlet offers traditional Japanese flavours and dishes prepared with attention to detail, giving guests another international dining choice within the property.
